answer: EY performed limited assurance under ISAE 3000 (Revised) over Shell's 2025 consolidated Sustainability Statements, including incorporated-by-reference information, against ESRS and EU Taxonomy Article 8 criteria. The report contains an internal page-range discrepancy that must be preserved: page 426 describes the statements as pages 335–423, while page 427 says the limited-assurance report covers pages 335–425 and incorporated references on pages 350–354. Other Annual Report information is excluded. Limited assurance uses procedures less extensive than reasonable assurance and does not provide all evidence needed for reasonable assurance; it also did not test controls or IT-system aggregation/calculations.
